submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on the token that completes a locally highly constrained chunk: a quantity or measure phrase (array dimension, dosage digits, 'after three days', 'calls for two'), a fixed collocation ('sea level', 'log n', 'range(10'), a verb-selected preposition or next recipe step ('stared at', 'twice in', 'and fry'), or the sentence-final period closing a formulaic factual report. The same token fires weakly when its preceding 1-3 tokens do not predict it, so activity is set by local contextual constraint, not by token identity; it carries no specific upcoming-token prediction (Jacobian kurtosis ~3.4, incoherent promoted lists).
